log.answer:
Part A: Using the principle of inclusion-exclusion, the number of integers in [1, 5000] divisible by at least one of 6, 10, or 15 is:
⌊5000/6⌋ + ⌊5000/10⌋ + ⌊5000/15⌋ − ⌊5000/30⌋ − ⌊5000/30⌋ − ⌊5000/30⌋ + ⌊5000/30⌋ = 833 + 500 + 333 − 166 − 166 − 166 + 166 = 1,334.
The count divisible additionally by 13 is:
⌊5000/78⌋ + ⌊5000/130⌋ + ⌊5000/195⌋ − 2·⌊5000/390⌋ = 64 + 38 + 25 − 24 = 103.
Subtracting yields 1,334 − 103 = 1,231.

Part B: Breaking each day's hours into regular (≤8), overtime 1.5× (8–12), and overtime 2× (>12):
• Regular: 12 days with at least 8 hours (96) + day with 6 hours (6) + day with 0 = 102 hours.
• Overtime (1.5×): 0+4+2+1+0+3+1.5+0+2+4+4+1.5+2+0 = 25 hours.
• Overtime (2×): 1 hour on each of days 2, 10, and 11 = 3 hours.
Gross pay = 102 × $22 + 25 × $33 + 3 × $44 = $2,244 + $825 + $132 = 3201.00.

Part C: Starting counting from Monday 2026-03-16:
• March (16–31): 12 weekdays − 1 holiday (2026-03-18) = 11 days (total 11)
• April: 22 weekdays − 0 holidays = 22 days (total 33)
• May: 21 weekdays − 2 holidays (2026-05-18, 2026-05-26) = 19 days (total 52)
• June: 22 weekdays − 2 holidays (2026-06-03, 2026-06-30) = 20 days (total 72)
• July: 86 − 72 = 14 business days needed. Weekdays in July are 1–3 (3 days), 6–10 (5 days), 13–17 (5 days), and the 14th day falls on Monday, 2026-07-20.

Part D: Monthly rate r = 0.069 / 12 = 0.00575, n = 48.
Monthly payment P = 31200 · r / (1 − (1+r)^−48) ≈ 745.676248.
Base balance at month 18 = 31200(1+r)^18 − P[((1+r)^18 − 1)/r] ≈ 20493.234487.
Savings from extra principal = 500(1+r)^16 + 300(1+r)^15 ≈ 874.980888.
Remaining balance = 20493.234487 − 874.980888 = 19618.2536 → 19618.25.

FINAL: 1231; 3201.00; 2026-07-20; 19618.25
